schemaChange: Suggested: add callbackUrl/webhookUrl columns to the ApiKeyCredential entity (napayment/onboarding-auth-rbac/src/main/java/ng/com/nawill/pay/onboarding/apikey/ApiKeyCredential.java) - a new Flyway migration, e.g. V0031__add_webhook_urls_to_api_keys.sql. Keyed by business (one active key pair per business, doc 2 §4.2), so there's no ambiguity about which key a URL belongs to.

request.notes: Both optional; either can be blank to clear it. Real implementation should validate reachability is NOT required at save time (a business may configure this before their endpoint is live).

relatedBackendWork: doc 1 FR-Recon-2 already calls for outbound webhooks notifying partners of transaction events - webhookUrl here is exactly the destination that feature would deliver to. Implementing outbound delivery itself is separate, larger work (FR-6/FR-7, backend v0.2).
